name: raudonas-run-1
pose: SPRINT RUN CYCLE frame 1 of 6 (CONTACT): pure side profile view facing RIGHT, the front (left) leg reaching forward with the heel just touching the ground, the back leg extended behind, the right arm swung forward with the elbow bent 90 degrees, the left arm back, body leaning slightly forward, focused determined grin. Same scale and framing as the other run frames: full body, feet on the bottom quarter line.

name: raudonas-run-2
pose: SPRINT RUN CYCLE frame 2 of 6 (DOWN): pure side profile view facing RIGHT, body at its lowest, the supporting front leg bent under the hips, the back foot kicking up behind toward the seat, arms passing the body with elbows bent 90 degrees, focused grin. Same scale and framing as the other run frames.

name: raudonas-run-3
pose: SPRINT RUN CYCLE frame 3 of 6 (PUSH-OFF / HIGH KNEE): pure side profile view facing RIGHT, the back leg straight pushing off the ground with the toes, the front knee driven high to hip height with the shin hanging down, the left arm forward, the right arm back, strong forward lean. Same scale and framing as the other run frames.

name: raudonas-run-4
pose: SPRINT RUN CYCLE frame 4 of 6 (FLIGHT): pure side profile view facing RIGHT, both feet off the ground, legs scissored wide, the front leg reaching forward, the back leg trailing, arms pumping, hair and headband ends flying back. Same scale and framing as the other run frames.

name: raudonas-run-5
pose: SPRINT RUN CYCLE frame 5 of 6 (CONTACT, other leg): exactly like frame 1 but with the legs and arms swapped: the right leg now reaching forward heel down, the left arm forward. Pure side profile facing RIGHT. Same scale and framing as the other run frames.

name: raudonas-run-6
pose: SPRINT RUN CYCLE frame 6 of 6 (FLIGHT, other leg): exactly like frame 4 but with the legs and arms swapped. Pure side profile facing RIGHT, both feet off the ground. Same scale and framing as the other run frames.
